Source: DECISIONS.md

Decisions log

MIT licensing decision (Step 5, closed)

The meta-package is MIT + file LICENSE (Copyright 2026 Aymeric Stamm). This is appropriate: the package redistributes ONLY in-house artwork (logos, theme SCSS, palette, all derived from the user’s own useR! 2026 talk) plus Font Awesome Free icon glyphs rasterized into the logos, which is permitted under CC BY 4.0 with attribution (recorded in inst/brand/NOTICE, which also covers the three.js render-scene provenance even though three.js is NOT redistributed here). No third-party JS/CSS/fonts are bundled: - three.js stays in rtists (MIT) — tractoverse ships only the PNG renders. - Inter / JetBrains Mono are declared source: google and loaded at runtime from Google Fonts (both SIL OFL 1.1) — not vendored, so no redistribution concern. Switching to self-hosted copies later WOULD require OFL notice + rename compliance, so prefer keeping Google-hosted if possible. - pkgdown favicons are rasterized from the in-house tractoverse logo by the RealFaviconGenerator service (attribution metadata embedded in pkgdown/favicon/favicon.svg); the output is the user’s own artwork, so no third-party copyrightable content is introduced. Re-check via inst/brand/NOTICE before shipping any new bundled asset (per the global licensing rule).

Branch protection (Item 7, decided)

  • Org-level repository rulesets require a paid GitHub Team plan (free orgs only get classic per-repo branch protection). Org Settings → Repository → Rulesets (https://github.com/organizations//settings/repository/rules) is the correct location, but the UI blocks enforcement without the upgrade.
  • Decision: keep free per-repo protection, modeled on toad. Apply the same policy to each remaining package as it completes its master→main rename (rtists, riot, bot). tractoverse, master, toad, fiber are already on main; toad and fiber are protected per the toad model, and master is protected matching its pkgdown-only CI (see the master item above for the deviation).
  • The toad model (the template for every repo’s default branch):
    • Required PR reviews: 1 approving review (dismiss-stale off, codeowner off, last-push-approval off).
    • Required status checks: macos-latest (release), windows-latest (release), ubuntu-latest (devel), ubuntu-latest (release), ubuntu-latest (oldrel-1), test-coverage — with strict = true (require branches up to date).
    • Block force-pushes (non-fast-forward): on.
    • Enforce for admins: off (matches toad — admin escape hatch).
  • Revisit org-level rulesets if the org ever upgrades to Team — a draft spec lives in the scratch copy of tractoverse-ruleset.md (not git-versioned).
  • mascot → toad GitHub rename is still pending (see running task list); the midi repo is legacy (merged into master) and intentionally left unprotected unless it needs to be archived.

pkgdown dark theme (pkgdown 2.2.1 architecture)

The dark brand for the pkgdown site is wired via template.bootstrap: 5 + template.bootswatch: darkly + template.theme: arrow-dark + pkgdown/extra.scss in _pkgdown.yml.

There is no separate pkgdown.css file in pkgdown 2.2.1 for Bootstrap 5. Custom Sass is compiled by bslib directly into docs/deps/bootstrap-5.3.8/bootstrap.min.css (via build_bslib()). A “missing pkgdown.css” therefore does NOT mean the theme failed — the compiled bootstrap.min.css should contain --bslib-preset-name: darkly, the extra.scss brand tokens (e.g. #0d1117 bg, #58a6ff accent, #161b22 surface), and the pre code span.* arrow-dark highlighting rules. Verify by grepping those markers in the compiled file.

pkgdown/ being in .Rbuildignore is irrelevant: bs_theme_rules() reads pkg/extra.scss via pkg$src_path from the source directory, not the temp-installed library. template.theme (default arrow-light) controls the syntax-highlight palette independent of the lightswitch toggle; set arrow-dark for a dark shell.

build_site() reports an accessibility check for README images missing alt-text — give the color swatches descriptive alt text (e.g. “fiber signature color #59aaea”).

Filenames

  • Dashes, not underscores for file/script/resource names (esp. in data-raw/); R function/object/variable names and .R files outside data-raw/ stay snake_case. (Recorded here and in AGENTS.md for future tasks.)

Codecov badge (toad, 2026-11-21)

  • toad’s Codecov badge showed 38% while its main branch measured 100% coverage (CI + v4 API + branch badge all confirmed 100%). Root cause: the codecov repo record keeps master as its default branch (left over from the old mascot repo; one stale session 2026-10-01 at 37.77%). The unpinned badge https://codecov.io/gh/<org>/<repo>/graph/badge.svg renders that stored default-branch aggregate; the branch-pinned form .../branch/main/graph/badge.svg renders the real main total.
  • Fix: pin Codecov badges to the default branch — toad PR #18 (b842382/17b3a1f), matching rtists’ existing convention. fiber/riot/bot still use the unpinned form (their codecov default currently matches main).
  • Optional future cleanup (not done): set Codecov’s default branch to main in the Codecov web UI (Settings → Repositories) so unpinned URLs also resolve. Not required once badges are pinned.
  • How to add a badge: convention recorded in AGENTS.md (“Badges”).

Logo family (approved art direction, light-bg redesign)

Task-specific logo build decisions — kept here, out of AGENTS.md, because they are specific to the logo-generation task and its regeneration runs.

The 6 package logos share a common shell:

  • Elements (only 3): the package name (much larger), a glyph (a transparent symmetric pyramidal tract that fans left/right and fills the hexagon), and a FontAwesome icon emblem.
  • Background: white / light. Border: black hexagon #111111, pointy-top, R = 300, canvas W = 520 (round(sqrt(3)R)), H = 600 (round(2R)).
  • Cone glyph: the exact-symmetric butterfly built from a single hemisphere via mirror_x_side="L" in build-scene.R: bL = cl[iL] (30 crown-sampled CST_L streamlines) as the left wing, right wing = mirror_x(bL) reflected across X = 0. This gives a perfectly symmetric cone (the two anatomy halves differ and would otherwise render right-hemisphere- heavier). Rendered at splay 0 (raw, uncanted anatomy), tinted with the package color.
  • Per-package color everywhere: tract, name, and icon all use the package palette color.

Emblem = FontAwesome icons

Use FontAwesome icons, per package (fontawesome v0.5.3; rsvg renders SVG → 600×600 RGBA PNG with the shape in the alpha channel, which is chroma-keyed into an alpha mask and tinted with the package color):

Package FontAwesome icon
riot feather-pointed
rtists palette
bot magnifying-glass-chart
fiber bezier-curve
toad book-atlas
master blender

Shared layout requirements

  • Horizontal centering of the tract is the common layout issue across all 6. It is a render/scene rotational asymmetry (the two anatomy halves differ: left bundle 5577 streamlines, right 2397; right half comes out consistently denser ⇒ right-hemisphere-heavier in every render, e.g. LR occupancy ratio ~0.94–0.99). Bbox-centering alone leaves the glyph subtly off the hex’s vertical axis. Guarantee the tract’s content centre-of-mass lands on the hex center (col W/2 = 260) rather than centering only the bounding box.
  • Vertical placement fills the pointy-top hexagon symmetrically (apexes near top/bottom).

Render parameters (agreed)

  • 30 streamlines per side (nL = 30, nR = 30).
  • Downsampling is done in the densest areas on the top area (the crown / uppermost part of each bundle), so the sparse fan stays even near the apex.
  • Re-implemented and PERSISTED in data-raw/crown-sample.R (canonical): crown_sample(bundle, n=30, z_frac=0.25) selects the crown (points at Z >= zmin + 0.25*(zmax-zmin), the uppermost slab), orders streamlines by their crown fan position (mean X of their crown points), then takes DETERMINISTIC even spacing (~ns/n rank step) for full-width, even-near-apex coverage. make_crown_strat(path, n) writes the list(iL=, iR=) index rds. The selection is validated by measurable pixel properties + user review (measured span: left crown-X ~[-48.8,-11.1], peak-Z ~[50.4,77.1]).

Build pipeline (canonical: data-raw/, driver = logo-family.R)

The minimal data-raw/ set regenerates the full 6-package light-bg family from scratch. Single entry point: Rscript data-raw/logo-family.R (from repo root; --pkg fiber smoke-tests one). Runs the exact-symmetric butterfly:

  1. crown-sample.R — crown_sample(), make_crown_strat().
  2. build-scene.R — PALETTE, make_scene() (mirror_x_side="L" single-hemisphere exact-symmetric butterfly: bL = cl[iL], bR = mirror_x(bL) across X=0; cam_view=c(0,1,0), cam_up=c(0,0,1), cam_dist=1.9), mirror_x(), patch_camera(), patch_axes(), mirror_depth(), splay_bundle().
  3. compose-core.R (low-level raster helpers) + compose-logo.R (compose_logo(), fa_tile()), which chroma-keys the white tract from the black-bg screenshot and centers the content centre-of-mass on col 260.
  4. screenshot.R — chromote (the webshot2 browser lib) + a Chrome-for-Testing build screenshots the served widget (--use-gl=swiftshader, 1200x1200 viewport, DPR=2).
  5. Widget is served in-process by httpuv::runStaticServer (no Python subprocess; srv$getPort() → screenshot.R; on.exit(httpuv::stopServer)).

cl/cr sourcing: logo-family.R loads CST_L/CST_R from the gitignored data-raw/.render/ cache (seeded: HCP1065_CST_L.rds 3.08MB / CST_R.rds 1.26MB). On a cold cache it pulls toad::HCP1065_CST_L/R() (GitHub-releases download, no caching in toad) and caches ~4.3MB. Verified identical to cl (5577) / cr (2397). make_crown_strat regenerates .render/crown_strat_30.rds.

Outputs → inst/brand/logos/{pkg}.png + tractoverse.png (1290x1680 white, 2x3 grid on a 600x520 canvas at 1-based origins: fiber(30,30), master(30,580), rtists(30,1130), riot(660,30), toad(660,580), bot(660,1130)).

Determinism: screenshot, compose, and crown-strat are all deterministic (two screenshots of one scene are byte-identical; crown indices reproduce exactly from the cached bundles). Regenerated logos should be structurally identical to the shipped ones (tract axis col 260, same bbox, glyph fills the hexagon); verify visually via the Positron Plots pane before overwriting inst/brand/logos/ (back up first).
